name: Hainanese Chicken Rice with Three Sauces

components.name: Poached Chicken

ingredients.name: Ice for chilling bath, not consumed

steps: Rub chicken with measured salt and place whole chicken in a large pot with water, ginger and scallions. Bring just to a simmer, keeping the liquid moving only gently.

Poach until chicken is fully cooked and a thermometer inserted in the thickest edible section reaches at least 74°C; timing varies by chicken size. Move cooked chicken into an ice bath for about 15 minutes, then drain and refrigerate.
Debone and weigh cooked chicken; portion cooked rice and each sauce separately. Maintain strict cooked-rice cooling hygiene.

components.name: Chicken Rice

ingredients.name: Reserved chicken fat from the whole chicken (not an additional purchase)
Poaching stock transferred into rice, included above

steps: Reserve chicken stock for rice and sauces. Remove the chicken fat from the cavity where possible; render it with 5 ml oil, cook garlic briefly, then stir-fry washed uncooked jasmine rice for 2 minutes.
Transfer rice to a lidded pot with approximately 950 ml hot reserved stock and measured salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook very gently until tender. Rest covered.

components.name: Three Sauces
steps: For ginger-garlic sauce, mince ginger and garlic, then heat briefly with 45 ml neutral oil and 1 g salt until aromatic; transfer to a separate covered jar.
For sweet soy, simmer measured water and rock sugar until dissolved, then stir in the dark soy sauce.
For chilli sauce, crush chillies, ginger and garlic, then blend with sesame oil, lime juice, rice vinegar, stock, sugar and salt.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Longer, advanced stovetop recipe with three sauces. Raw chicken weighs 1.5 kg bone-in; macros from edible meat estimate. Cooking broth is reused as rice cooking liquid, so count the liquid only once.
Storing & reheating: Freeze cooked chicken and rice separately if necessary; fresh-made dipping sauces give best flavour. Chill rice rapidly.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.

Store at 4 C or colder for no more than 3-4 days; freeze portions intended for later in the week.
Cook chicken and reheat leftovers thoroughly to 74 C. Ground pork must reach at least 71 C before serving; food-safe reheating still requires 74 C.
Rice must be rapidly cooled and chilled; never leave cooked rice standing for extended periods.
